verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents zero-data-retention agreements with all its model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data (lorikeet-docs-42), plus independently verified compliance reports on a Vanta Trust Center (lorikeet-docs-41). That is a vendor-side retention posture, not a control the customer can set. Missing for 10: customer-configurable retention periods, a user- or admin-initiated deletion or purge mechanism, documented deletion SLAs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
